mechanism.claim: During elevated completed realized variation, an official hourly lower-shadow rejection candle is bullish when its body is below or near the prior low (Hammer) and bearish when its body is above or near the prior high (Hanging Man). Enter only an unambiguous official context output for eight hours.
mechanism.side: long for Hammer-only +1, short for Hanging-Man-only -1; ignore a bar satisfying both contexts
mechanism.why_distinct: Unlike wick-imbalance reversal, the lower shadow direction alone does not determine side. Identical short-body, long-lower-shadow morphology is mapped through causal location relative to the prior candle: below/near prior low versus above/near prior high. Official lagged body, upper-shadow, and near-range settings are fixed; no fitted outcome, reused event set, volume, flow, OI, or funding is used.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: contextual rejection at a prior hourly extreme can resolve sharply while trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation ranks in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse hourly candle-shape plus prior-extreme context clocks are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 60 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-1h,T)
features.hammer: official ready Hammer condition true and Hanging Man false
features.hanging_man: official ready Hanging Man condition true and Hammer false
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed five-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 2160 earlier source-valid hourly decisions, minimum 720, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.recursive_reset: hour aggregation, all candle-setting totals, readiness, and variation history reset after any invalid completed source hour

clock.feature_available: hour boundary after completed rejection candle
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: official LEAN contextual lower-shadow pair under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no timeframe, candle settings, context, ambiguity, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, control, or other repair.

external_basis.origin: Hammer and Hanging Man candlestick patterns; QuantConnect LEAN canonical implementations
external_basis.fixed_definition: current real body < factor 1 prior-10 real-body average; lower shadow > factor 1 current real body because ShadowLong period is 0; upper shadow < factor .1 prior-10 high-low average; Hammer body low endpoint <= prior low + factor .2 prior-5 high-low Near average; Hanging Man body low endpoint >= prior high - the same causal Near average
external_basis.warmup: LEAN Period is max(BodyShort 10, ShadowLong 0, ShadowVeryShort 10, Near 5)+1+1 = 12 hourly bars
external_basis.selection_use: official defaults, strict/inclusive inequalities, outputs, and readiness only; no incidence or outcomes
